plugins.name: cstack
plugins.description: Crishon's own Claude Code skills (caveman, deslop, write-a-skill, bootstrap-agents, web-design-guidelines) and the karen verification agent. Matt Pocock's skills now come from his own plugin.

plugins.name: plain
plugins.description: Keeps everything we publish readable for a junior developer or product manager with no outside context: writing rules, a checker, a blank cold reader and a hold before posting. Opt in per repository with .claude/plain.json.

plugins.name: agent-browser
plugins.description: Pinned external: vercel-labs browser-automation skill (was 'dogfood' in Hermes skills-lock)

plugins.name: vercel-agent-skills
plugins.description: Pinned external: vercel-labs agent skills (composition patterns etc.)

plugins.name: pstack-picks
plugins.description: Pinned pointer to four of Lauren Tan's pstack skills (pstack 0.15.13, MIT): never block on the human, show your work (a reviewable decision log), encode lessons in structure, and unslop. show-me-your-work needs the other two, so they come together.

plugins.name: rn-callstack-picks
plugins.description: Pinned pointer to three of Callstack's React Native skills (MIT): performance (frames per second, bundle size, startup time, native), React Navigation, and React Native upgrades. Install only in projects with a React Native app.

plugins.name: rn-vercel-picks
plugins.description: Pinned pointer to Vercel's React Native coding rules (lists, animation, navigation, UI patterns, state, monorepos). Pointer only: the source repository has no license. Install only in projects with a React Native app.
